notes: Size 4.5" from the frame size in the model name (the datasheet doesn't state it). Xmax 3 mm is half the published linear coil travel (6 mm peak to peak). Mms 9.39 g is the published moving mass plus air load (9.2 + 0.19 g). Coaxial: the woofer's parameters (the tweeter's are left out).
